prs.body:
## High Level Overview of Change

The PermissionedDEX code paths (CreateOffer and Payment) check credential validity via `accountInDomain()` in PermissionedDEXHelpers.cpp, but this function uses a ReadView — making it architecturally impossible to delete expired credential SLEs from the ledger. Expired credentials persist indefinitely, locking owner reserves and causing permanent ledger bloat.

### Root Cause

The XRPL uses a two-phase cleanup pattern for expired credentials:

1. `preclaim()` (ReadView): identifies expired credentials, suppresses tecEXPIRED to allow doApply() to run

prs.body:
## High Level Overview of Change

This change updates the Permissioned DEX invariant to ignore deleted domain offers when validating the transaction’s active DomainID under `fixCleanup3_4_0`.

Previously, replacing a Permissioned DEX offer from Domain A with a new offer in Domain B could incorrectly trip `tecINVARIANT_FAILED`, because the invariant still tracked the deleted Domain A offer and compared it against the new transaction’s Domain B. With this change, deleted domain entries are excluded from the post-amendment domain set, while the legacy behavior is preserved before `fixCleanup3_4_0`

## Pull request overview

Updates the Permissioned DEX invariant’s domain tracking so that, under `fixCleanup3_4_0`, domains referenced only by *deleted* offers/dir nodes don’t cause a false invariant failure when an offer is replaced into a different domain.

**Changes:**
- Adjust `ValidPermissionedDEX` to track domains in two sets and, post-`fixCleanup3_4_0`, validate only non-deleted domain entries.
- Add a regression test that replaces a Permissioned DEX offer from Domain A to Domain B via `OfferCreate` + `OfferSequence`, asserting pre-/post-amendment behavior.

issues.title: [PermissionedDEX] `ValidPermissionedDEX` invariant does not check `badHybrids_` for Payment transactions
issues.author: q73zhao
issues.body:
## Summary

The `ValidPermissionedDEX` invariant collects `badHybrids_` data in `visitEntry()` for all transaction types, but only checks it in `finalize()` when `txType == ttOFFER_CREATE`. If a Payment transaction resulted in a malformed hybrid offer (e.g. missing `sfDomainID`), the invariant would silently pass.

## Severity

Low. Defense-in-depth gap. No current payment code path modifies hybrid offer structure fields (`lsfHybrid`, `sfDomainID`, `sfAdditionalBooks`), so this cannot be triggered through normal transactions today. issues.title: [PermissionedDEX] `book_changes` RPC merges domain and open book volumes into same tally entry
issues.author: q73zhao
issues.body:
## Summary

The `computeBookChanges` function in `src/xrpld/rpc/BookChanges.h` builds its tally map key from the currency pair string only (e.g. `"XRP_drops|USD/gateway"`), without incorporating the domain ID. When both a domain offer and an open offer for the same currency pair are crossed in the same ledger, their volumes are incorrectly merged into a single entry and the `domain` field is overwritten by whichever offer is processed last.
